## We’ve seen plenty of jobs go off-plan. So we built for it.

If there’s one thing commercial GCs know, it’s that jobs rarely go exactly to plan. RedTeam was built for that reality. Since 2006, we’ve helped contractors bring more order to the work and get a clearer read on the business behind every job.

We know you’ve got plenty of tools already. So RedTeam’s not here to add another to the pile. Instead, we’ve worked hard to design a construction management software platform that actually meets the everyday realities of the job.

That means bringing your project work, paperwork, and financials all into one place, with a partner who doesn’t just leave you to figure things out yourself.
